description: Run an IA-EVAL test suite (.ia-eval.yaml contract): call the model per scenario; return passed (true, false, null if undecided) and a verdict (PASS, FAIL, PARTIAL). Expectations are assertions that fail a scenario whatever its score; evaluators give the score. Hosted: pass inline_contract. validate_only calls no model.

api_keys.description: Your keys per provider. Only Groq falls back to the server key; any other provider needs yours.

contract_path.description: A .ia-eval.yaml under the server's working directory (local use).

inline_contract.description: The contract as an object: "metadata" ({name, version, model?, provider?}), "expectations", "evaluators" and "scenarios" ([{id, input, expectations?}]). generate_eval_yaml scaffolds one.

validate_only.description: Check the contract against the IA-EVAL schema and stop: no model call, no key, deterministic. Returns valid + issues instead of throwing. Gate a PR that edits a contract on valid.

name: run_eval_contract
